theorems.name: Submission.dtc_bc_lc_good_level
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (g : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ≥0∞) (μ : ℕ → Measure (Euclid P)) (h : Euclid P → ℝ) (good : ℕ → ℝ → Prop) (a b : ℝ), a < b → Measurable h → (∀ i, AEMeasurable (g i) (volume.restrict (Ioo a b))) → (∑' i, ∫⁻ t in Ioo a b, g i t) ≠ ∞ → (∀ i, μ i {x | a < h x ∧ h x < b} ≠ ∞) → (∀ i, ∀ᵐ t, good i t) → ∃ t ∈ Ioo a b, (∀ i, good i t) ∧ (∑' i, g i t) ≠ ∞ ∧ ∀ i, μ i {x | h x = t} = 0
